definitions.explanation: A lesson or moral learned from experience, a story, or an event. Also used for instructive advice or admonishment meant to guide future behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{教訓|きょうくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: I learned a lesson from the failure.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教訓|きょうくん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is the moral of this story?

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教訓|きょうくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かして、⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}した→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
examples.english: Drawing on lessons from past disasters, they strengthened disaster prevention measures.

notes:
USAGE:
{教訓|きょうくん} refers to wisdom gained from experience or narrative. It can be the moral of a fable, a practical lesson from a real-world event, or advice given to prevent future mistakes. Common in both literary discussion and practical contexts (business, disaster preparedness, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教訓|きょうくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to learn a lesson
- {教訓|きょうくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす: to apply a lesson
- {教訓|きょうくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a lesson behind
- {教訓|きょうくん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: an instructive story

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教|おし}え→教える：00526_oshieru⟧: teaching, instruction (more personal, from a teacher)
- ⟦{戒|いまし}め→戒め：20179_imashime⟧: warning, admonition (emphasis on caution)
- {教訓|きょうくん}: lesson, moral (emphasis on wisdom gained from experience)
